newsitem.title: FINLAND: MERITA SURGES ON OVERSEAS DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: MERITA SURGES ON OVERSEAS DEMAND.

text.p: Shares in Finnish banking group Merita Oy rose sharply on Wednesday on foreign demand, partly sparked by an outperformer stance from U.S. investment bank Goldman Sachs, brokers said.
At 1113/0813 GMT, Merita traded at 19.00, up 0.90 markka or 4.97 percent after hitting 19.30 earlier. Trade was a lively 43 million markka.

But other brokers pointed out there was no news to support the rise, adding it may be speculative. They could not pinpoint a source for speculation, but pointed to expectations of more consolidation in the Nordic financial sector.
"There is talk that someone may know more than others," said one. "These levels are surely speculative," said another.
But he also said some analysts' target prices for Merita are between 20 and 22 markka.
